The E1 lead, its E8 return and C205 form a series LC near the 1.5 MHz BQ25798 switching frequency (JP24, EM19). At the 90 mm E1 maximum f0 is 1.430 MHz (1.471 MHz at the r6 85 mm). The undamped Q is 19.1 (19.3 at 85 mm), an upper bound from the DC wire resistance; the skin-effect Rac gives 13.0. With R276 the Q is 0.111 (zeta 4.5, overdamped). R276 x C205 is a 159 kHz low-pass: a 1.5 MHz REGN ripple reaches C205 at 0.106 of its EVM amplitude (T-C-16). **E1 load (r7 correction):** E1 carries only the EIB REGN loads, namely the gate pull-ups R252 (Q201) and R254 (Q202), the Q203 gate-source resistor R271 and, while released, the feed through Q203 and R255. R272 and R272b sit on the EVM and draw from REGN there, not through E1. I_E1 is 0-0.111 mA held and 0.272-0.396 mA released (REGN 4.8-5.2 V). The R276 drop is 1.02 mV at the H.15 E1 load (0.102 mA, held, R254 only) and at most 3.96 mV (released, regen clamp, REGN 5.2 V). That drop lowers the released ILIM_HIZ level by at most 1.786 mV, which lowers IINDPM by 2.23 mA (safe direction). Held levels do not change: Q203 is off and no feed flows. R276 open acts as an E1 lead off (fault table, first row); R276 shorted restores the undamped r6 circuit (T-A-02 meters R276 at 10.0 ohm +-1 %) |
